name: Platform waiting bench row (three-seat bench + two-seat bench + potted plant)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; benches face south into the platform with the plant standing at one end.

offset_basis_summary: Three_Seats_Green_Bench_Frontal_1 and Two_Seats_Green_Bench_Frontal_1 sit in the same row of the 20_Subway_and_Train_Station sheet (y304, x320/352), so their offsets are sheet_relative. Plant_Vase_1 lives in an unrelated sheet region, so its position at the end of the row is hand-authored.

pieces.notes: Placed past the end of the three-seat bench, out of the seating footprint. Footprint widened 5->6 tiles and dx 4->5 (bugfix: the old dx=4 placed the plant's 16x32 rect on top of the three-seat bench's own 48x16 rect at x64-80, a 50% solid/solid overlap that check-city-plan.py OVERLAP flags — dx=5 clears the bench row's x32-80 span entirely).

variants.bench_color: Swap me.subway.bench_green for bench_grey/bench_black (same relative frontal_1/frontal_2 layout on their own sheet rows).
variants.row_length: Chain additional two-seat/three-seat frontal benches to lengthen the row.

notes: Sheet-relative bench pair (both frontal_1 variants share the same y=304 row) dressed with a hand-placed potted plant to close off the row end, matching how these props read on a real platform.
